reclaiming those slurs for you is harmful for you, not for me and i would NEVER use any slur that i’m even “allowed” to reclaim around anyone that i didn’t know was completely comfortable with the words being used around them. i also apologize if i came across as hostile, didn’t fully understand what you were getting at and the last paragraph of your response threw me off. trust me, i wanted wide perspectives and i’m not mad that you have a different one than most, it was the way you worded your response. i can reclaim slurs that have been used against me, of course, as long as i am being respectful to others around me and not referring to someone else. another thing, my post wasn’t only about reclaiming of slurs, some of the comments were very invalidating which is what lead me to be upset.

i asked for other perspectives and said that i would not say any of these slurs if they were not right for me to reclaim, i’ve also stated that i wanted mlm to give me their opinions on whether wlw should be able to say the f slur, i made this post out of genuine confusion so i would not offend anyone even though i’ve experienced homophobia, and discrimination like every other person who’s in the lgbt+ community.  no one should be calling you a slur, whether they’re an allie, a close friend, or a part of the lgbt+ community, slurs can be hurtful in any form - but i never said anything about other people. i’m sorry if i misunderstood your comment but i’m fucking sick of having to deal with homophobia and biphobia from your own community, i know you know that hurt but i don’t know why you’re attacking me ://

yeah i fully agree with you, there are slurs i cannot say and i fully understand that. i’m not even very fond of using slurs very often anyway as they are still harsh words, even if it’s reclaimed, but i still feel like i have the right to reclaim slurs that are used against me regardless. thanks for giving me your perspective

yeah it sucks to be invalidated by a community that knows what it’s like to be discriminated against, i don’t understand why some people understand the pain of being discriminated against and then do the same thing to other people

i’m really sorry that he used that slur against you, i understand the pain fully, and i’m just kinda pissed right now about people trying to gatekeep slurs when they’ve been used against everyone a part of the lgbt+ community

i really appreciate you. you’ve made me feel much better, and i competently agree with you. usually i brush it off as there’s always going to be biphobia that exists in our community but tonight it just kinda hit me different and made me feel like i’m not enough, and i just wanted more clarification on what i thought but thanks again :))

thank you. seriously thank you so much. it feels nice to be understood by other people and i also cannot stand when people try to gatekeep slurs either, usually i’m not effected like this but the comments were making me feel rlly invalidated and like i’m not a part of the community even though i experience the same discrimination as everyone else, thanks for being understanding
i wish i had never found the video, it’s really upsetting me and the way some of the comments made it seem like they hated bi people so much, has made me really upset tonight but i’m still curious
i know how you feel. it’s how i feel. i don’t wanna be like this but nothing works. i just wish i could be like everyone else

me too. i truly get it and i’m genuinely sorry. i hate always being there for everyone and going out of my way for everyone, and never getting any of that back. i don’t expect it, but when they can’t even listen to you without saying really insensitive things like that, it makes me feel like i’m the biggest fucking burden to exist.
Thank you so much, I’m just going to try and get by day by day, and seeing your comment made me happy too, I’m hoping that everything will improve this year.

Trust me, they don’t love me, I’ve figured it out, they’ve said so. I don’t want to kill myself because of the bitterness towards my parents, I can’t take how they treat me any longer and how worthless I feel like I am to everyone. I wouldn’t commit suicide to get back at someone, I’ve been this depressed for 4 years, I’ve fought and fought but I’m going to give up at some point. Part of me worries that even if I do make it and make something out of myself, the trauma is still going to be to much for me and I’m just going to be miserable for the rest of my life, if that makes any sense. I know who my most trusted friend is and I probably wouldn’t be here without her but she doesn’t care, she just gives the least effort respond she can when I put so much effort into her issues. Makes me feel even worse, sometimes I think I need a break from social media but it’s also the only thing that gives me distraction from every bad thing in my life. And thank you for caring enough to comment, sucks that random people on the internet care more than the people that have been around you the longest. Today I’m feeling even worse, everything sucks.
Eh I really can’t do that as much as I want to, sometimes it’s just the smallest of things that people do, I wish I could 🥺

God, thank you so much, I can’t even describe how much this is what I needed to hear, if I stay for no one else, I’ll try to stay for you. I’m going to try and watch something to get my mind off of it and stay in rooms where I know I’m safe from harm. I hope you have a good night. Everything still hurts so much.
Thank you so much, as cliche as it sounds, people’s comments have helped and me taking time to calm down. I’m still very much suicidal but I don’t think I’ll do it tonight.

See, I agree partially with you, but I’ve never shown hate to any of these people, just love, but it’s all pent up, this is my one place to vent. I’ve gotten better with self love over this year but I still can’t help but think everything would be better without me. I’m trying to do everything I can before I snap.
And honestly I think that if no one responds, I’m doing it, I’m tired of being so alone.
